title: thelypteris simplex
intro: Thelypteris simplex, commonly known as the maiden's hair fern, is a plant species in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Caribbean region, due to its reported health benefits, which include aiding in the treatment of respiratory issues, such as asthma and bronchitis. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris simplex include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of the plant have been identified as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
